description: This file defines a HashRing struct used for consistent hashing in Orleans streaming queue adapters. It includes methods for managing ring members, calculating responsible queue IDs based on hash codes, and converting the ring to a string representation.

classes.name: HashRing
classes.description: An internal readonly struct implementing consistent hashing for queue distribution in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: HashRing
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the hash ring with a sorted array of QueueIds.

methods.name: GetAllRingMembers
methods.description: Returns all QueueIds in the ring.

methods.name: CalculateResponsible
methods.description: Calculates which QueueId is responsible for a given hash code, using clockwise traversal.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of all QueueIds in the ring.
